_readme: Weighted loot tables, used by every map whose Files/loot/<map>.json has rules.source "tables".
containers: container template id (or "default") -> how many items (min..max) and from which table.
loose: chance that a loose-loot point of the map gets an item, from which table; filterByPoint keeps the map's own filter of each point (e.g. a shelf that only takes ammo).

tables: name -> entries. id = an item template id or a category id (then any item under it). weight is relative: 10 is ten times as likely as 1. count = stack size range for money/ammo. name and price are only for reading; they are not used.
A map file can carry its own "tables" object with the same three parts; its entries replace these.
Made by Tools/make_loot_tables.py (weight = 1000 / sqrt(price x stack) x rarity); edit freely.
